headline: David Robinson, who helped lead OpenAI's Safety Systems team, has left the company, another departure from its safety staff.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: the departure was first confirmed on 2 Oct 2026, but the article gives no reason for it.
importance_line: What changed: another senior person from OpenAI's safety side has left, which matters most to people who rely on OpenAI's safety reporting, then to its remaining staff and regulators, and the doubt is that the article gives no reason for Robinson's departure.
summary: Business Insider reports that an OpenAI spokesperson confirmed on Friday 2 Oct 2026 that David Robinson, a leader on its Safety Systems team who worked on system cards (public documents that describe its models), left last week. New since 1 Oct 2026, when OpenAI said it had parted ways with three researchers it said had broken its rules on sharing sensitive information: Business Insider calls this another upheaval among OpenAI's safety staff, after safety head Johannes Heidecke left earlier this year.
notes: Follow-up of 1002:C12-03 (WSJ, 1 Oct 2026). Robinson left 'last week'; the news was first confirmed 2 Oct 2026, so the score was not lowered.
